dialogues.speaker: Zinovia
dialogues.text: ...Take care, Yeshina. Don't go running around like that. Your condition is finally showing signs of improvement, so it's best you don't catch a chill.

dialogues.speaker: Yeshina
dialogues.text: Alrighty, alrighty! Celaeno will take me back in a few days. Once I've seen my {RUBY#[D]Augury Bird} mom and dad, I'll get better, right?

dialogues.speaker: Zinovia
dialogues.text: Yes... but that will only soothe you for a little while. Until we find a permanent cure, we still have to stay here...

dialogues.speaker: Yeshina
dialogues.text: Hmm... So we have to stay in Snezhnograd for a long, long time before we can see Linnea?

dialogues.speaker: Zinovia
dialogues.text: Yeah... That's all we can do now.

dialogues.speaker: Yeshina
dialogues.text: Huh? But why are you looking so worried?

dialogues.speaker: Yeshina
dialogues.text: Didn't Celaeno tell us that Linnea is a brilliant, brave, and incredibly reliable adventurer now?

dialogues.speaker: Zinovia
dialogues.text: ...Yes... she is. She's so good... and yet we...

dialogues.speaker: Yeshina
dialogues.text: So, once I'm all better, let's bring the sweetest, yummiest candies from the Zapolyarnyn and go see Linnea! That way, our family can finally be together again!
